title: EASTGATE CORPUS INVENTORY — all engines and generators for K-N HUD living world
principle: Review and ingest into Gaia as gut-brain. The engines ARE the organs. The generators ARE the cells.

nestGate.role: THE GATE — Rust gateway, 17 crates, the infrastructure skeleton
nestGate.gaia_organ: BONES + SKIN — the infrastructure skeleton and boundary

ludoSpring.role: THE GAME ENGINE — science of play, interaction, procedural generation

procedural.wfc: Wave Function Collapse — constraint-based generation (dungeons, chemistry, structures)
procedural.bsp: Binary Space Partition — Doom-style level generation (rooms, visibility, rendering)
procedural.noise: Perlin/simplex noise — terrain, density fields, molecular distributions
procedural.lsystem: L-systems — biological growth patterns (protein backbones, plant morphology)

game_engine.world: tile map + movement + discovery — 7 RPGPT planes

interaction.goms: GOMS cognitive model (Goals, Operators, Methods, Selection)
interaction.input_laws: Fitts' Law, Hick's Law for input timing

ludoSpring.gaia_organ: BRAIN + STOMACH — the thinking engine and the digestive processor

airSpring.role: THE WEATHER ENGINE — atmospheric science, feeds, environmental sensing
airSpring.gaia_organ: LUNGS + EARS — the breathing engine and the environmental listener

wateringHole.role: THE COMMONS — shared resources, recipes, schemas, protocols, evidence
wateringHole.gaia_organ: MOUTH + HEART — the intake commons and the coordination center

world_generation.wfc: Wave Function Collapse — CAN generate tile maps for the globe surface
world_generation.bsp: Binary Space Partition — CAN subdivide the HUD into rooms/zones
world_generation.noise: Perlin noise — CAN generate terrain, clouds, atmospheric effects
world_generation.lsystem: L-systems — CAN grow organic structures (trees, mycelium, coral)
world_generation.voxel: Voxel engine — CAN render block worlds at any scale

interaction.rpgpt: 7 game planes — CAN make the HUD interactive (explore/dialogue/tactical)
interaction.npc: NPC system — CAN give personality to the 9 organ-primals
interaction.dialogue: Dialogue engine — CAN make messenger conversations procedural
interaction.flow: Flow detection — CAN adjust HUD complexity to viewer engagement
interaction.accessibility: Accessibility — CAN ensure HUD works for all viewers

rendering.raycaster: First-person rendering — CAN add depth to the globe
rendering.gpu_dispatch: GPU compute — CAN offload heavy rendering to WebGPU
rendering.scene: Scene system — CAN compose multi-layer views
rendering.tufte: Tufte visualization — CAN make data beautiful and honest

infrastructure.nestgate_rpc: RPC system — CAN connect HUD to live data sources
infrastructure.discovery: Service discovery — CAN find and connect to primals
infrastructure.security: Security/ZK — CAN verify identity without exposing secrets

gut_brain_drain.status: ALL INGESTED INTO GAIA AS GUT-BRAIN
